title: Decaying Orbit
announcement: Orbit decaying. The Meridian will meet the atmosphere in a few rounds, and there are fewer escape pods than crew. Board one, or restart the engines and save the ship for everyone. I am obliged to mention that the second option is harder.

roles.name: Survivor
roles.briefing: The Anomaly tore something loose and the Meridian is falling. You have seven rounds before it meets the atmosphere. The Escape Pod Bay (or the Airlock) holds pods for all but one of you. The Engine Room (or the Engineering Landing) might restart with three good tries, and then everyone aboard lives. Everyone wins or loses alone. Help, or take a pod.
objectives: Be off the ship or on it when it climbs: take a pod, or restart the engines (Tech 6+, three times).
